body.name: \(\widetilde\Psi_i\)
body.def: the foldwise plug-in version of \(\Psi_c(O_i)\) obtained by substituting \(\widehat\theta_c\), \(\widehat m^{(-\ell)}\), \(\widehat e^{(-\ell)}\), empirical gradients, and \((\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}})^{-1}\) for every occurrence of \(H_c^{-1}\), then subtracting its empirical mean at each \(c\)
